states.message:
Welcome to CoverScore Personal™.

This short Family Protection Score™ helps you reflect on how prepared your household may be for income, health, and family emergencies.

It takes about 3 minutes.

Reply START to begin.
states.invalid_message:
To begin your Family Protection Score™, please reply:

START

states.message:
Before we begin:

CoverScore will use your answers to prepare your private score and practical next steps.

We do not ask for bank details, passwords, PINs, BVN, NIN, or card information.

Reply:

1 — I agree and want to continue
2 — Show me the privacy summary
3 — Exit
states.invalid_message:
Please reply with:

1 — I agree and want to continue
2 — Show privacy summary
3 — Exit

states.message:
How many people depend on your income or financial support?

1 — None
2 — One person
3 — Two to three people
4 — Four to five people
5 — More than five people
states.invalid_message:
Please reply with a number from 1 to 5.

For example:

3 — Two to three people

states.message:
How much does your household depend on your income?

1 — My income is not essential to household expenses
2 — Others can cover most expenses
3 — I cover about half of household expenses
4 — I cover most household expenses
5 — I am the main or only income source
states.invalid_message: Please reply with a number from 1 to 5.

states.message:
If you were unable to work or earn income unexpectedly, how long could your household continue meeting normal expenses?

1 — Less than one month
2 — One to three months
3 — Four to six months
4 — Seven to twelve months
5 — More than one year
6 — Not sure
states.invalid_message:
Please reply with a number from 1 to 6.

For example:

2 — One to three months

states.message:
Do you currently have life assurance or a protection plan that could support your dependents if you were no longer able to provide income?

1 — Yes, and I believe it is adequate
2 — Yes, but I am not sure it is enough
3 — Yes, but it is limited
4 — No
5 — Not sure
states.invalid_message:
Please reply with a number from 1 to 5.

If you are unsure, reply:

5 — Not sure

states.message:
Do you currently have health insurance or an HMO plan for yourself?

1 — Yes, with broad cover
2 — Yes, but limited cover
3 — Yes, through work, but I am not sure of the benefits
4 — No
5 — Not sure
states.invalid_message: Please reply with a number from 1 to 5.

states.message:
Are your spouse, children, or other dependents covered by a health plan?

1 — Yes, all are covered
2 — Some are covered
3 — No
4 — Not sure
states.invalid_message: Please reply with a number from 1 to 4.

states.message:
Do you have savings set aside specifically for unexpected expenses?

1 — Yes, enough for more than six months of expenses
2 — Yes, enough for three to six months
3 — Yes, but less than three months
4 — No
5 — Not sure
states.invalid_message: Please reply with a number from 1 to 5.

states.message:
Do you currently pay school fees or education-related expenses for anyone?

1 — No
2 — Yes, for one person
3 — Yes, for two or more people
4 — Not currently, but I expect to within three years
states.invalid_message: Please reply with a number from 1 to 4.

states.message:
If your income stopped for six months, would those education expenses remain manageable?

1 — Yes, comfortably
2 — Yes, but with some difficulty
3 — Probably not
4 — No
5 — Not sure
states.invalid_message: Please reply with a number from 1 to 5.
